skill_name: In 150 words, explain why technology is important in today's society.
workflow: Technology has become increasingly important in today's society, both for the work environment and our personal lives. It helps us stay connected with the world, even in times of physical distancing. Technology can make us more efficient in our lives, helping us complete tasks with ease and speed. For example, with the help of technology, we can communicate more efficiently, generate more ideas, produce more efficient work, and quickly access information from all over the world.
